Coram : ARIJIT PASAYAT*, R.V. RAVEENDRAN
Writ Petition-Maintainability of, when disputed question of facts are C involved-Held: Not maintainable-Remedy is to approach proper forum so that evidence could be analysed-Industrial Disputes Ac.I, 1947-Section 25- F, 25-B. Respondent was working as casual worker in appellant-corporation. He service but the same D was rejected. Thereafter, he sought relief by filing writ petition. Appellant denied his claim of having worked for 240 days. High Court allowed the Writ Petition on the ground that the burden to prove that respondent had not worked for more than 240 days in twelve months
Decision Date : 23-11-2005 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 1909/2005 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
